dict.string: Jev Notch listens only while you hold Command so it can transcribe your spoken command.
Jev Notch uses on-device macOS speech recognition to turn your held-Command voice input into a tool request.
Jev Notch reads and creates calendar events only when Jev selects a calendar tool you requested.
Jev Notch reads and creates reminders only when Jev selects a reminder tool you requested.
Jev Notch searches contacts to resolve people explicitly named in your request.
Jev Notch controls supported Mac apps only after Jev selects the requested action.
